gaps.explanation: Governmental detail holds only the Schedule of County Treasurer Activity (trimmed p13, printed p34; indices 0-7, total 210,084), which is the 'Property taxes' row of the Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds - Cash Basis (trimmed p4, printed p8: General Fund 191,969 + Street Fund 18,115 = 210,084). No other row of the p4 fund columns is in detail. Added every other non-zero revenue cell of the General Fund, Street Fund and Keno Fund columns exactly as printed on p4 (Debt Service Fund column all '-'; Property taxes row excluded, it is the County Treasurer schedule already in detail). The General Fund 'Sales and other taxes' cell is added as the single printed cell 102,069 (p4), not split into the budget schedule's all-funds Sales tax 94,224 / Other state receipts 7,845 (p8) as pass 1 did (held: all-funds figures filed under the General Fund); category 'taxes' since the row mixes sales tax and other receipts. General: 102,069 + 23,161 + 166,908 + 58,908 + 304,248 + 6,100 + 2,000 + 2,166 = 665,560 (= 857,529 - 191,969); Street: 20,903 + 11,407 + 170,256 + 1,220 + 3,599 = 207,385 (= 225,500 - 18,115); Keno: 170,769. Added 1,043,714; 210,084 + 1,043,714 = 1,253,798 = statement total.
